items.title: AI Stocks Diverge as Democratic Election Victory Sparks Rotation Into Cloud Giants
items.summary: US technology stocks experienced a significant shift in investor positioning on Wednesday, as the Democratic Party’s election victory raised concerns about potential restrictions on new data centre developments. Investors moved toward established cloud computing companies while reducing exposure to semiconductor manufacturers and AI infrastructure developers.

items.title: Dan Ives: Big Tech Free Cash Flow “Will Trough in 1H2027” as Capex Growth Peaks Early
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co. now expects Big Tech’s capex growth to peak in 2027, and free cash flow at Microsoft, Meta, Alphabet and Amazon to bottom in the first half of that year.

items.title: Citi Raises AI Revenue Forecasts Through 2028 as Cloud Demand Accelerates
items.summary: Citi has increased its artificial intelligence service revenue forecasts for 2026 through 2028, citing sustained demand for AI services and stronger monetisation across major cloud computing providers. The investment bank raised its AI revenue estimates by 9% for 2026, 7% for 2027 and 17% for 2028, reflecting expectations for continued expansion in AI-related cloud services.
